features: Navigator-based recorder for LILIN IP cameras, PTZ domes, DVRs/NVRs and ONVIF cameras
Up to 72 channels 1080p / 3M / 4M / 5M / 8M / 12M network streaming and recording
Failover up to 36 channels per server
Ethernet controllers: Intel I219V and Intel I210
notes: Recording HDD count differs between sources: up to 3 x 3.5" SATA HDD (product page feature list) vs up to 8 x hot-swap 3.5" SATA HDD (specification table, catalogue). Drive bay count left out.
Weight differs between sources: 10.50 kg net (product page) vs 10.50 kg gross (catalogue). Weight left out.
Operating temperature differs between sources: 0 - 50 C (product page, catalogue) vs 0 - 60 C (A&E spec). Operating temperature left out.
HDMI output differs between sources: 1 x HDMI 1.4b (4096 x 2160@24Hz) (product page) vs 1 x HDMI 1.4 (4096 x 2160@30Hz) (catalogue). HDMI output left out.
AI camera pairing differs between sources: 16 channels (product page) vs 36 channels (catalogue). AI camera pairing left out.
Product page and catalogue give 5 USB ports (rear 2 x USB 2.0 and 2 x USB 3.2 Gen1, front 1 x USB 3.0); A&E specification gives 7 (rear 1 x USB 2.0, front 6 x USB 3.0). USB port count left out.
Built-in OS SSD size differs: 500 GB (product page), 256 GB (catalogue), 120 GB (A&E specification). Built-in SSD size left out.
